methodology: Purposive selection of accessible official announcements and independent reporting; short original paraphrases only. No full articles or customer comments stored. Dates distinguish announcements, scheduled availability, effective dates and reporting. Current page versions may include later edits. This is not an exhaustive incident census or a causal dataset.

events.title: Ray-Ban Meta announced
events.description: Meta and EssilorLuxottica announced Ray-Ban Meta glasses with camera, audio, livestreaming and voice AI functions.
events.limitation: Product claims are company statements, not independent performance tests.

events.title: Announced retail availability
events.description: Meta specified 17 October as the start of online and retail availability.
events.limitation: The source establishes the scheduled release, not stock in every market.

events.title: Visual AI beta expansion
events.description: Meta announced visual AI beta rollout in the US and Canada, alongside video calling and additional styles.
events.limitation: Rollout was gradual and geographically limited.

events.title: Long-term partnership extended
events.description: EssilorLuxottica announced an extended Meta partnership into the next decade for successive smart-eyewear generations.
events.limitation: The agreement signals commitment; it does not establish future commercial success.

events.title: External facial-search demonstration
events.description: The Verge described students combining glasses footage with external identification services; it also questioned recording-light visibility.
events.limitation: An external demonstration, not a native Meta facial-recognition feature.

events.title: US voice-data settings change
events.description: The Verge reported US changes to camera-AI defaults and removal of the voice-storage opt-out; deletion remained available.
events.limitation: Historical US settings; do not generalise to every region or current firmware.
events.date_basis: US effective date attributed to Meta in reporting

events.title: Meta distinguishes captured media from sharing
events.description: Meta told The Verge that ordinary camera-roll media was not training material; sharing to other services invoked their policies.
events.limitation: A company explanation, not an independent processing audit.

events.title: India launch announced
events.description: Meta opened Indian pre-orders and announced retail availability from 19 May, expanding the geographic product footprint.
events.limitation: Availability does not establish adoption, satisfaction or trust.

events.title: Gen 2 announced
events.description: Meta announced Ray-Ban Meta Gen 2, including longer battery life and higher-resolution video.
events.limitation: Specifications are manufacturer claims; no inference about consumer sentiment.

events.title: Commercial growth and legitimacy tensions
events.description: Reuters described a revenue contribution from smart glasses alongside privacy concerns, bystander exposure and emerging competition.
events.limitation: Analyst expectations and reported commercial growth are not evidence of wider-brand damage.

events.title: Reports of sensitive footage review
events.description: SvD/GP reported workers' accounts of sensitive glasses footage being reviewed.
events.limitation: Worker accounts; the original investigators said they had not seen the annotation material.
events.date_basis: Publication date of the cited original English-language investigation, not a claim of first coverage

events.title: Meta describes contractor review safeguards
events.description: Meta acknowledged some AI-content review by contractors and said privacy filtering preceded it.
events.limitation: A safeguard claim, not proof of effectiveness or universal footage access.
events.date_basis: Report publication date; Ars places the statement to BBC on 4 March

events.title: Prescription-focused styles announced
events.description: Meta announced Blayzer Optics and Scriber Optics, taking AI eyewear further into prescription-oriented daily use.
events.limitation: Announcement and positioning do not establish clinical or privacy benefits.

events.title: Audio line and Gen 3 expansion
events.description: Meta announced Ray-Ban Meta Audio and Gen 3, broadening its eyewear range and describing a built-in capture indicator for Gen 3.
events.limitation: An indicator signals capture; visibility does not itself establish bystander consent.

events.title: Senators request privacy explanations
events.description: Senators Markey and Wyden requested answers about reported non-consensual capture, contractor access and AI training.
events.limitation: An inquiry is not an adjudicated finding; its 25 November response deadline is after this review cutoff.
